fan.text: In this synthetic move, Saka drives forward out wide, then sends the ball infield to Gyokeres.
Gyokeres supplies the finish: his shot travels into the goal, completing the move.

analyst.text: Saka’s recorded carry advances toward goal while staying wide. His completed pass then travels mostly across the pitch into Gyokeres’s central position.
The sequence suggests a wide-to-central attacking route: forward progression through Saka, followed by an inward delivery rather than another forward pass.
Gyokeres’s shot begins slightly beyond the pass endpoint and travels toward the centre of goal. The goal event confirms the finish at the captured cutoff.
